facts.label: There was/were
facts.sub: Use There was para uma coisa e There were para várias no passado: There was a baby lion. There were five monkeys.

facts.label: Havia um
facts.sub: Para falar de uma coisa no passado, use There was: There was a baby lion. A forma negativa é There wasn’t. Pergunte com Was there a café near the exit?

facts.label: Havia vários
facts.sub: Para falar de muitas coisas no passado, use There were: There were five monkeys. A forma negativa é There weren’t. Pergunte com Were there any monkeys?
